samples.summary: Added comment overstates the surrounding convention: "Same reason every sibling mutation below notifies" is false for the three block-type mutations immediately below (`toggleList` at 2871, `indent` at 2886, `outdent` further down) which do not call `notifyStyleApplied()`. The repo's own task note (docs/tasks/active/20260817-block-type-toolbar-refresh-todo.md:21-27) records exactly this. A future reader will assume coverage the code lacks.
samples.evidence: editor.ts:2807-2811 comment vs. toggleList/indent/outdent ending in `render();` with no notify.

samples.summary: Fix is narrower than the class of the defect: `toggleList`/`indent`/`outdent` mutate block type/list level through the same `doc.setBlockType` path and still never fire the cursor-move callbacks. The task doc argues this is unobservable today (no control derives rendered state from list kind/level), which is a defensible scope call, but it leaves the invariant the lessons doc states as a 'contract' unenforced for three siblings. Worth an explicit note or follow-up rather than silence in code.
samples.evidence: editor.ts:2871-2885 toggleList ends in render() with no notifyStyleApplied; docs/tasks/active/20260817-block-type-toolbar-refresh-lessons.md:8-10 calls ending such mutations with notifyStyleApplied 'part of the contract'.

samples.summary: Second added test pins the ⌘⌥2 keyboard path, which this change does not touch (the todo explicitly says it was already correct). Mild scope creep beyond the issue's fix, harmless as a regression pin but it broadens the diff past the single-line behavioral change.
